description: Chad - Aerodromes is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Chad. Shapefile with point features for airports and airfields in the country. Base layer and structure comes from WFP (2015). Updates have been made by OCHA to keep the dataset up-to-date. Coverage: Chad. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Chad. Its tags are aviation, facilities-infrastructure, geodata, transportation. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2026-04-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
